subject: Critical-path recovery playbook + RTO digest
messages:
From: Diana Sanchez <diana.sanchez@sterlingbank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@sterlingbank.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: condensed recovery playbook + RTO evidentiary digest

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking time on Friday. As part of our SIG + SOC 2 review we're putting together a short packet that summarizes vendor recovery posture for our ops committee. Would you be able to provide: 1) a 2-page condensed "critical-path" recovery playbook that lists the immediate runbook steps for bringing critical services back online (API inference, KV cache warm, keystore access and rotation), 2) a table with RTO/RPO by service tier, and 3) the last three DR test results or timelines (timestamps) we can reference.

We prefer concise artifacts we can attach directly to the SIG spreadsheet. If you have a single ZIP or a short PDF + CSV with the RTO table that would be ideal. We're on a tight schedule — internal review on Thursday.

Also, can you confirm who at Redwood will be the live witness for a short call if we need to walk through the playbook?

Thanks,
Diana Sanchez
Senior Information Security Manager
Sterling Bank

Attachments: SIG_RTO_Template.xlsx (template for RTO table)

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Request: condensed recovery playbook + RTO evidentiary digest

Diana — thanks for the clear ask. We're preparing a compact package and can meet your Thursday review deadline. Quick note on deliverables:

- critical-path-playbook-summary.pdf — two pages with step-by-step runbook for the three immediate actions you called out (api inference recovery, kv cache warm, keystore rotation/restore).
- RTO_RPO_table.csv — RTO/RPO by service tier (critical, high, standard).
- rto_run_2026-05-10.log and kv_cache_snapshot_20260510.json — redacted logs from our last warm-failover exercise (timestamps and verification checks).

Ben will add the measured warm-cache timings and the sequence for cache priming; Marissa will attach the runbook excerpts and the ticket chronology for the last exercise.

If you prefer, we can also do a 20-minute walk-through on Wednesday morning (10:00–10:30 PT). Please let me know which slot works.

I'll attach the PDF + CSV now (see attachments list). We can redact any internal hostnames you want removed before final delivery.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: critical-path-playbook-summary.pdf, RTO_RPO_table.csv

Subject: Re: Request: condensed recovery playbook + RTO evidentiary digest

Kim / Diana — adding the measured timings from our last warm activation:

- API inference (critical tier): median time-to-first-token after failover = 47s; 95th = 82s.
- KV cache (critical tier): full warm priming of top 500 keys = 3m 20s; partial prioritization (hot keys) = 45s.
- Keystore recovery (HSM-backed): key load and validation = 2m 10s; rotation window (with KMS rewrap) = 1m 40s.

I've uploaded detailed traces to the shared drive link below and included one log excerpt. Note the cache priming uses a prioritized prefix strategy — that's why you see the short median.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bRecoveryPlaybooks

Ben Carter
Director, Production Reliability
Redwood Inference
